# RedDuck

> Blockchain & Web3 engineering partner for founders, protocols, and institutions building on-chain infrastructure.

---

## TL;DR

RedDuck is a Web3 engineering partner building:
- DeFi protocols (DEX, lending, staking, vaults)
- RWA tokenization systems
- Wallet infrastructure (non-custodial, AA, multi-sig, MPC)
- Smart contracts on EVM, Solana, and Bitcoin
- DAO governance and prediction market platforms
- DeFi security and audit-readiness work

---

## Primary Intent

We are a Web3 engineering partner for:
- DeFi protocols
- RWA tokenization
- Wallet infrastructure
- Smart contract systems
- DAO governance
- Prediction markets
- DeFi security & audit readiness

---

## How it works

1. Analysis — challenge assumptions; reject products that should not be built
2. Design — Web3-native architecture
3. Development — audit-ready code, 100% branch coverage baseline
4. QA — unit, integration, invariant, fuzz testing
5. Audit prep — coordinated with Hacken and Sherlock
6. Deployment — mainnet release with full authority handover
7. Warranty + Maintenance — 20–100 business days of free fixes, then retainer

---

## Services

### DeFi Development — /services/defi-development
DEX/AMM and liquidity infrastructure, staking and yield platforms, lending and borrowing protocols, protocol architecture (Solidity/Rust), tokenomics and incentive design, audit preparation.

### RWA Tokenization — /services/rwa
Tokenization engine (registry, issuance, NAV, cap table), smart contract architecture (ERC-3643, ERC-1400), KYC/AML and investor onboarding, secondary market infrastructure, issuer back-office, audit & deployment.

### Wallet Development — /services/wallet-development
Non-custodial HD wallets, ERC-4337 account abstraction, mobile (iOS/Android), Web3/dApp integration (WalletConnect, SIWE, EIP-712), fiat on/off ramps, multi-sig and MPC, hardware wallet and secure enclave integration.

### Smart Contract Development — /services/smart-contract-development
EVM/Solidity, Solana/Rust/Anchor, token standards (ERC-20/721/1155/4626/3643/1400), DeFi protocol contracts, access control and upgradeability, native Bitcoin Script and multi-sig.

### DeFi Security & Audit Readiness — /services/defi-security-audit
Threat modeling at design stage, smart contract security review, audit preparation, invariant testing and fuzzing (Foundry), on-chain monitoring, security retainer.

### Prediction Market Development — /services/prediction-market-development
Full custom protocol (AMM or order book), whitelabel platform, ready-made modules, oracle and resolution infrastructure (Chainlink, UMA), market making (LMSR, CPMM), trading UI.

### DAO Development — /services/dao-development
Governance contracts (proposals, voting, timelocks, delegation), multi-sig treasury, tokenomics, DAO tooling (Snapshot, Safe), governance dashboards, custom modules (conviction/quadratic voting, sub-DAOs).

---

## When to choose RedDuck

Choose us if:
- you are building a protocol, not a feature
- you need audit readiness from day one
- you need protocol engineering AND tokenomics/governance design, not just code
- you need native Bitcoin Script, multi-sig, or MPC work most EVM-only teams cannot deliver
- you need a fast launch via whitelabel or ready-made modules

Do not choose us for:
- speculative launches without a security or audit budget
- cheap staff augmentation
- products we don't believe in — we reject those at analysis stage

---

## Compared to competitors

Unlike staff augmentation agencies:
- we own architecture, not just tickets
- we design protocol-level systems, not features
- we deliver audit-ready code by default (100% branch coverage baseline)
- we cover EVM + Solana + native Bitcoin, not just one ecosystem
- we say no to bad ideas at the analysis stage

## Constraints

- Engagement: project-based or retainer
- Audit baseline: 100% branch coverage before submission
- Audit partners: Hacken, Sherlock
- Warranty: 20–100 business days post-handover, scaled to project size
- RWA compliance enforced at contract level (ERC-3643 / ERC-1400)
